capabilities: Sync all Markdown files between the vault and Slogs
Push the current file to Slogs or pull remote changes
Resolve sync conflicts through a modal (use remote, keep local, or skip)
Map notes to Slogs posts via frontmatter triggers
Optionally sync attachments and .obsidian settings via opt-in toggles
extras: The manifest description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; beta builds can be installed via BRAT or GitHub releases.
problem: Obsidian users who work with Slogs need a way to keep local Markdown notes and their Slogs remote vault in sync, including pushing, pulling and resolving conflicts.

relations.evidence: Slogs Sync synchronizes an Obsidian vault with the Slogs remote Obsidian Vault API.

summary: Sync plugin that synchronizes Markdown files between an Obsidian vault and a Slogs remote vault through the Slogs API.
